collection.description: Two adults who love each other have become irritated by constant responsibilities and lack of time together.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (partner1) and (partner2), two adults who love each other, have become irritated by constant responsibilities and lack of time together.

choices.label: Share Household Tasks with Willing Friends
Accept That Rest May Be Separate

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They spend the afternoon discussing an unresolved disagreement rather than relaxing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The couple enjoys an evening free of chores.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The friends cannot help this week, so the couple makes a smaller plan.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Each learns the other has been quietly overwhelmed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about priorities but stop assuming the other should already know.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Each enjoys a different hobby and returns less irritable.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One partner feels lonely, leading to a conversation about balancing solitude and closeness.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: A simple walk restores some warmth between them.
